entities.name: IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED
entities.description: A protocol state where the UE has initiated IMSI detach procedure.

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating tracking area and performing location registration.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed when configured for eCall only mode at timer expiry.

entities.name: T3444
entities.description: Timer used in eCall only mode operation.

entities.name: T3445
entities.description: Timer used in eCall only mode operation.

entities.name: Configured for eCall only mode
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for emergency call only operation.

relations.description: UE in IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED state shall initiate combined tracking area updating procedure.
If configured for eCall only mode, UE shall perform eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3444 triggers eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3445 triggers eCall inactivity procedure.
